C1598.title: New IoT Botnet Uses Tor to Obfuscate C2 Communications
C1598.summary: Security researchers found a new Gafgyt malware variant attacking D-Link routers and other IoT devices, using Tor to obfuscate C2 communication and evade detection. The botnet infects IoT devices and turns them into controlled nodes that hide malicious activity and receive C2 commands. DDoS capability claims should be supported by sources describing that capability if retained.
